title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account: Activation, Blocks, Closure and Plan Changes
content:
## Activation and closure of a never-used account

On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account, activating the card is the cardholder's own act. A never-activated account with a zero balance closes when the worker withdraws consent to wage payment by card, or when the employer's Payroll Card Program ends.

## Blocks

- The desk blocks only an account whose status is active.
- The desk blocks the card at once when the cardholder:
  - reports the card lost or stolen (block reason lost or stolen);
  - reports transactions they did not make (block reason suspected fraud);
  - asks for a temporary block (block reason cardholder request).
- A block stops every debit but never stops loads.
- A lost or stolen card number is never reactivated. That block lifts only when the cardholder activates the replacement card, whose new last four digits are recorded when the replacement is ordered.
- A suspected fraud or cardholder request block lifts when the cardholder confirms the card is in hand and says which transactions they made.

## Closing the account

Closing the account is the cardholder's own decision. The desk registers a closure request, and the remaining balance is paid out by check free of charge or by transfer to the cardholder's bank account. The account closes once the balance is zero.
- A closure is confirmed only for an account whose status is active.
- An account is not closed while any of its disputes has the status submitted or investigating.

## Plan changes

The card plan follows the employer's Payroll Card Program package, and it changes on the day the employer's package changes. The cardholder cannot choose or buy a plan.

## Status at a glance

| Status | Can be blocked by the desk | Closure can be confirmed |
|---|---|---|
| issued | no | no |
| active | yes | yes, when no dispute is submitted or investigating |
| blocked | no | no |
| closed | no | no |

*Hypothetical case:* an active account with one dispute under investigation and a balance of 61.15 asks to close. A closure request is registered, but the account does not close while the dispute is still under investigation.
